title: LinkedIn Character Counter
description: Check text against LinkedIn's real limits — posts (3,000), headlines (220), About (2,600) and more — with live remaining.
howto: Pick the LinkedIn field you are writing for.

faqs.a: Post 3,000 · Headline 220 · About section 2,600 · Company page about 2,600 · Message 8,000 · Comment 8,000 · Article headline 100. This tool covers the main writing fields.
